from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-2/play/users/u046/system/state/workspace/programs/task-92cbfc79.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 2]
    by_row = {}
    for r, c in points:
        by_row.setdefault(r, []).append(c)
    axis_row, axis_cols = next((r, cols) for r, cols in by_row.items() if len(cols) >= 2)
    left, right = min(axis_cols), max(axis_cols)
    for c in range(left, right + 1):
        if out[axis_row][c] == 0:
            out[axis_row][c] = 3
    for r, c in points:
        if r == axis_row or not (left <= c <= right):
            continue
        step = 1 if r < axis_row else -1
        rr = r + step
        while rr != axis_row:
            if out[rr][c] == 0:
                out[rr][c] = 3
            rr += step
    return out
'''
